youtube.title: Mike Tyson: a hard life, or his own fault? You score it
youtube.description: Reportedly 38 arrests by 13, his mom died when he was 16, and at 20 he became the youngest heavyweight champion ever. Hard? Brutally. Blameless? No. Facts checked against Wikipedia (Mike Tyson, Cus D'Amato, Buster Douglas, Evander Holyfield articles); primary sources were not accessible.

tiktok.caption: Mike Tyson: a hard life, or his own fault? Hard? Brutally. Blameless? No. You score it.
